root_cause.text: Missing payload length validation in l2cap_information_rsp() allows out-of-bounds reads when a truncated L2CAP_INFO_RSP packet is processed, because the code only checks for the fixed header length but not the required payload size before accessing rsp->data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit length checks `cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32)` for L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK and `cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0])` for L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN, and the CVE description confirms that without these checks, a truncated response triggers an out-of-bounds read of adjacent skb data.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add length validation before reading feature mask from L2CAP information response to prevent out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check `if (cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32))` before assigning `conn->feat_mask = get_unaligned_le32(rsp->data)` in the L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK case.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code now verifies that the received command length is sufficient to contain both the response header and a 32-bit feature mask before reading the mask. If the length is insufficient, the assignment is skipped, preventing an out-of-bounds read.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add length validation before accessing rsp->data[0] to prevent out-of-bounds read in L2CAP fixed channel info response handling.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check (if (cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0]))) before assigning conn->remote_fixed_chan = rsp->data[0].
intent_record.how: Prevents reading rsp->data[0] if the command length is insufficient, avoiding potential out-of-bounds access.
